title: Mamata Banerjee moves Calcutta HC challenging Bhabanipur election loss to BJP's Suvendu Adhikari
description: Trinamool Congress chief Mamata Banerjee has filed an election petition in the Calcutta High Court challenging her defeat in Bhabanipur, where BJP's Suvendu Adhikari beat her by 15,105 votes in the 2026 West Bengal assembly elections.
